text:
alex: Heads up — Orion SI says 2 racked cabinets from PO# R-4421 are held at Port 7 due to customs paperwork mismatch. ETA slipped from 04/21 to 05/06. This blocks EU Dedicated onboarding next week. cc @jen_si @maria
jen_si: Yep, sorry — broker flagged missing C-3 import declaration. Partner is re-filing now, but current ETA assumes next available manifest on 05/06. Trying to get a same-week correction.
maria: What capacity does this impact? Which customers are on the reserved racks? @liam can we reshuffle?
liam: Impact = 2 racks (~192 A100s) for EU-dedicated pool. We have a 1-rack buffer in the emergency reserve (non-customer pinned). Can we use hosted warm pool for failover? :thinking:
sara: Please paste manifest and broker ref. Also open escalation with SI legal/broker — customs holds escalate slowly.
jen_si: Manifest snippet + broker ref below.
jen_si: ```
MANIFEST: MFT-ORION-99821
PO: R-4421
ITEMS: 2x Cabinet-Rack-42U (serials redacted)
BROKER_REF: BRK-55932
HOLD_REASON: Missing C-3 declaration
ETA_LATEST: 2026-05-06
```
jen_si: Partner says broker will attempt correction today, otherwise they can divert to FRA staging for quicker customs clearance but that adds 24-36h handling.
alex: Short-term plan proposal:
- liam allocate 1 rack from emergency reserve to cover onboarding slot (owner: liam, due: EOD today)
- liam + jen_si coordinate diversion to FRA if broker can't clear by 05/02 (owner: jen_si)
- sara open escalation ticket with carrier + broker (owner: sara)
- maria draft customer comms for impacted onboarding windows (owner: maria)
liam: I can shift 1 rack from reserve. Need explicit sign-off to commit — will mark as temporary and track deallocation window.
maria: I'll prep a short note for customers and ask product to delay canary push by 48h unless we confirm arrival earlier. draft in #product-comms then share here.
jen_si: Partner offers to waive late-delivery penalty and provide 2 weeks of burst credits on Dedicated for affected customers. They'll confirm in writing by EOD. :+1:
logistics-bot: Reservation R-4421 status updated: delayed -> customs_hold (broker_ref: BRK-55932) at 2026-05-01T14:12:00Z
alex: Thanks all. If no blocker, liam allocate the rack and sara escalate. I'll update runbook and ping legal if needed. Keep updates here — next sync 05/02 09:00 CET. :white_check_mark:
